title: Representative transpose for H-zero scalar normalization
statement: For a chosen K-flat complex P and a complex M representing finite derived input, the normalized finite enriched scalar transpose has the displayed H-zero Hom identity on every degree-zero class for the quotient images Q(P) and Q(M).

source.place: Tags 03CZ, 079P and 08JA; representative transpose calculation before transport to arbitrary derived objects.

proof.text: Choose the fixed K-injective replacement of M. The finite tensor normalization and closed uncurrying equation identify the enriched comparison with the ordinary extension/restriction transpose on the product Hom complex. Apply the fixed zero-cycle and representative-evaluation normalizations to obtain the displayed equation on every degree-zero class.
The remaining transport from quotient images Q(P), Q(M) to arbitrary derived inputs uses K-flat resolutions and naturality, and is a separate step of the parent statement.

proof_origin.place: Extracted representative part of the H-zero scalar transpose calculation.
